summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only) I read the full path end-to-end: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus `modules/auth/handlers.ts` and `db/auth.ts`.  The obvious suspects from the ticket description **aren't actually present**: - Every watchlist route requires the `arca_session` cookie and enforces `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` on every read/write — no default/guest watchlist, no anonymous fallback. - The client never touches
